title: Jolly George Varghese v. Bank of Cochin

content.caseIdentity: Jolly George Varghese v. Bank of Cochin, (1980) 2 SCC 360
content.holding: Under Section 51 CPC read with Article 21 and Article 11 of the ICCPR, a judgment debtor cannot be imprisoned merely for poverty or honest inability to pay a civil money decree; there must be bad faith or contumacious refusal to pay.
content.relevance: Human rights and constitutional restraints on civil arrest and detention.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1980) 2 SCC 360; 1980 INSC 22; 1980 (2) SCR 913; Section 51 CPC and Article 11 ICCPR against civil debtor imprisonment.
